messages:
raj: Proposing to lift the soft-pin and unpin runtime v2.14 on the canary pool for quant-q4k models tomorrow 09:00 PT. Reason: perf regressions from v2.13 fixed and kernel fallback removed. Need QA signoff, SRE hold window, and a clear rollback plan.

tess: Quick q — did we validate long-seq latencies with the new KVCACHE hotpath? last run looked promising but only 30m of traces.

alice: I ran the long-seq sweep overnight (10k tokens, mixed batch sizes). No tail latency spikes in canary logs, p50/p95 improved ~6-8% vs pinned runtime. I uploaded the summary to the release notes draft: https://internal/release-notes/3865 (see perf table).

mike: QA found one decoding mismatch in top-k sampling tests for model q4k-1.2 on 512 seq. It's intermittent (2/120 runs). I added repro logs in the ticket: INF-983.

raj: Thanks Mike — can you paste the repro snippet here? Need to know if it's model or runtime.

mike: Repro: ```python
resp = client.generate(model='q4k-1.2', input='repeat test', max_tokens=512, top_k=40)
# mismatch observed: token 278 sometimes 0x3f instead of expected 0x2a
```

sarah: That looks like a sampler seed/order race we saw with the older GPU driver. Driver on canary nodes was bumped last week; I've verified nodes are on driver 540.2 and CUDA 12.2. Suspect nondeterminism fixed by kernel reorder in v2.14.

raj: Proposed unpin criteria: 1) QA flake rate <1% on 1k sampling runs (mike to confirm), 2) no tail latency regressions >5% on long-seq sweep (alice validated), 3) canary error budget <0.5% over 4h after rollout. Rollback triggers: a) sampling mismatch frequency >1% persistently, b) p99 latency >10% above baseline for 30m, c) SRE manual abort. Rollback plan below.

raj: Rollback plan (copyable):
1) Pause canary traffic: `deploy-bot pause --pool canary-runtime-v2-14`
2) Reapply pin: `deploy-bot pin-runtime --version v2.13 --scope canary`
3) Clear new kernel cache and restart runtime on affected hosts: `ssh ops@host 'sudo systemctl restart redwood-runtime'` (automated script at infra/scripts/rollback_v2_13.sh)
4) Re-run QA smoke: 100 sampling runs and 1 long-seq trace.
5) Notify customers via status page if rollback > 10 minutes.

deploy-bot: Notice: current pinlist for canary: runtime=v2.13, sdk=1.12.3, models pinned: none. Scheduled actions require explicit `deploy-bot apply` from release lead.

tess: Can we add a canary gating step to ramp traffic 0->20->60->100 over 15m with health checks at each stage? That should reduce blast radius.

raj: Yes. Ramp plan: 0->20 (5m) -> 60 (7m) -> 100 (3m). Health checks: p95 latency delta <5%, error rate <0.2% at each step. If any check fails, automatic stop and SRE alert.

mike: QA: I re-ran 1000 sampling tests with the exact client call. Intermittent mismatch dropped to 0.3% after forcing deterministic seed in the client (so sampler nondeterminism in default path). With default seed it's 1.1% — borderline. My recommendation: proceed but gate SDK minor bump that forces deterministic sampling by default.

alice: Note: SDK team is prepping a 1.12.4 that flips the default sampler seed for q4k models. That will be released next week. If we unpin runtime without that SDK change, some customers might see flakiness.

raj: Given tradeoffs, I suggest: unpin runtime on canary tomorrow but hold full fleet unpin until SDK 1.12.4 is out. Canary will include a client patch that sets seed deterministic for sampling tests only. If canary looks good 24h, plan staged unpin for next week post-SDK.

oncall-sre: Acked. I'll put a maintenance window on the cluster 08:45-10:00 PT and monitor the canary pool. I'll be pager-on for the ramp. If anything crosses thresholds I will abort and execute rollback plan.

deploy-bot: Action queued: `unpin-runtime --version v2.14 --scope canary --window 2026-03-21T09:00:00-07:00 --ramp 0-20-60-100 --healthchecks p95<5%,err<0.2%` (requires `deploy-bot apply` by raj).

raj: I'll apply at 08:55 PT, will post status here when started. Thanks everyone — please add any last blockers now. :thumbsup:

tess: No blockers from infra side. :+1:

mike: QA follow-up ticket created INF-984 to track post-unpin sampling validation.

raj: Starting apply at 08:55 PT. Will update with step markers.

(08:56) deploy-bot: `apply` accepted by raj. Unpin will execute at 09:00 PT.

(09:05) deploy-bot: Stage 1 (20%) complete. Health checks: p95 delta 3.2% (ok), error rate 0.05% (ok).

(09:12) deploy-bot: Stage 2 (60%) complete. Health checks: p95 delta 4.5% (ok), error rate 0.08% (ok).

(09:16) deploy-bot: Stage 3 (100%) complete. Health checks: p95 delta 4.6% (ok), error rate 0.09% (ok). Canary stable at 09:16.

raj: Canary looks healthy after 30m. Holding fleet unpin until SDK 1.12.4. Leaving thread open for any regressions.

sarah: Noted — will audit driver/kernel shim over next 24h to ensure no creeping nondeterminism.

mike: QA: sampling mismatch trend after canary: 0.4% in 2k runs (with default client). Logging INF-983 updated. Looks acceptable for staged rollout.

raj: Closing action items: 1) mike -> INF-984 for post-unpin checks, 2) SDK -> ship 1.12.4 (target next Tue), 3) SRE -> monitor 24h. Thanks team.

(09:45) deploy-bot: Thread note: unpin completed for canary at 09:16 PT. Pinlist updated.
